facts.text: Wellesley students can cross-register for classes at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, Babson College, Brandeis University, and Olin College of Engineering, with access to dual-degree engineering programs.

sources.title: Limitless educational opportunities from Wellesley (and friends!)
sources.quote: Cross-registration with Babson, Brandeis, MIT, and Olin College of Engineering: even more classes, dual-degree programs with Olin and MIT, and access to the Bernard M. Gordon-MIT Engineering Leadership Program and the MIT Undergraduate Research Opportunities Program.
